verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the Jin Mao Tower in the Lujiazui Financial District.
verified_facts.excerpt: Occupying floors 54 to 87 of the iconic Jin Mao Tower in the Lujiazui Financial District

verified_facts.text: The hotel features an octagonal pagoda design.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel features an octagonal pagoda design embodying exquisite oriental luxury

verified_facts.text: The hotel has panoramic views of the Bund and the Huangpu River.
verified_facts.excerpt: it commands panoramic views of the timeless Bund scenery and the glittering Huangpu River

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a 33-storey central atrium.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel’s soaring 33-storey central atrium creates an architectural masterpiece

verified_facts.text: Rooms combine allusions to art deco heritage with classical Chinese style.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring allusions to art deco heritage combined with the essence of classical Chinese style

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a separate deep-soaking bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows offering sweeping views of the Pudong skyline welcome guests to this spacious 42 sq m (452 sq ft) room. Enjoy elegant art deco design, a generous work area, wireless Internet access, a separate deep-soaking bathtub

verified_facts.text: Club rooms include access to the Grand Club Lounge, which serves breakfast, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.
verified_facts.excerpt: Includes access to the Grand Club Lounge offering a private boardroom and serving breakfast, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has views of the skyline and the Bund, a kitchen, and a bath with a jet-spa tub and sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: suite that offers stunning skyline and the Bund views. Enjoy art deco design, a king bedroom, a sitting room, a work area with wireless Internet access, a kitchen, and a large bath with a jet-spa tub, high-pressure shower and sauna

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite and Chairman Suite come with 24-hour butler service.
The sky-high pool has panoramas of the Shanghai skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Feel alive in the sky-high pool, which features breathtaking panoramas of the Shanghai skyline.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours and private training instructors are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 24-hour Fitness Center features extensive hi-tech equipment including cycling machines, spinners, treadmills, cross trainers and strength machines. Private training instructors are also available

verified_facts.text: Cloud 9 on the 87th floor is a Western-style restaurant and sky-high lounge with full-scale Shanghai views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 87‑floor tower top, Cloud 9 operates as a Western‑style restaurant and sky‑high lounge with full‑scale Shanghai views.

verified_facts.text: Club Jin Mao on the 86th floor has private dining rooms with views over both banks of the Huangpu River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched on the cloud‑high 86th floor of Jin Mao Tower, exclusive private dining rooms deliver a tranquil retreat with sweeping views over both banks of the Huangpu River.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has seven restaurants and bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our collection of seven distinctive restaurants and bars serves refined Chinese and international cuisines

verified_facts.text: Yu Garden is 0.96 miles from the hotel.
Shanghai Metro Line 2 is 0.6 kilometers from the hotel.
Pudong International Airport is 40 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
verified_facts.excerpt: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

verified_facts.text: Guests must wear a swimsuit and a swimming cap in the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: we kindly request that all guests wear an appropriate swimsuit and a swimming cap when using the pool
